concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Two consistent ovoid faces with coarse irregular polygonal reticulum, warm brown cell floors and pale raised ridges, one projecting horn per visible broad face. Concept horns are more prominent and diagonal than requested; freeze short horns rooted on opposed broad faces near apex, not edge horns. The tapered apex is an ovoid outline, not a third horn. Ignore concept painted speckling; geometry carries reticulation with quiet cell centers. True lenticular thickness authored intentionally; sheet is not a measured orthographic pair.
concept.hidden_surface_decisions: Rear face receives matching coarse network and exactly one opposite near-apical horn. Closed lenticular perimeter and basal seam; no microscopic papillae or whole plant. Horns meet core with embedded bases.
